column1: # Requested by FRONTIER-REQ-EC7-LABEL-TO-OWNER-MAPPING for FINAL-AUDIT pass 20.
# check_call_chains.py abstains on the "documented in both directions" test because the
# Owners-crossed column of _index/CALL-CHAINS.md uses CodeDomain labels that no page
# writes as a single token. This file maps every label form the 46 documented chain
# rows use to the primary-owner token the corpus carries (owners.tsv vocabulary, the
# PrimaryOwner: frontmatter values, and the NN-* category directories).
#   chain_label   the exact token as it appears in the Owners column
#   owner_token   the canonical owner name (owners.tsv / PrimaryOwner:<token>)
#   category_dir  the database category directory that owns the domain
# A chain_label may appear more than once when it spells two owners
# both-directions test should treat a multi-owner row as satisfied when every
# mapped owner is documented at the row's document.
